title: TRICARE Select Outpatient Deductible
content:
**Rule.** The **TRICARE Select** deductible applies per calendar plan year of the service date, to network and non-network outpatient care alike, and never to a service class listed among the tier's deductible-exempt service classes. Inpatient facility lines take the deductible only where the tier applies the outpatient deductible to inpatient facility charges. A line applies to the deductible the smaller of its allowed amount net of any other health insurance payment, the patient's remaining individual deductible (the tier's individual deductible less the individual deductible already met in the plan year) and the family's remaining family deductible (the tier's family deductible less the family deductible already met in the plan year). A denied line applies nothing to the deductible. Lines are accumulated in adjudication order; a line adjudicated later for an earlier service date does not reopen deductibles already met.

## Deductible applied on a paid line

The deductible applied is the smallest of three amounts, and never below zero:

1. the line's allowed amount less any other health insurance payment on it;
2. the patient's remaining individual deductible;
3. the family's remaining family deductible.

## Worked lines (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A: individual 150.00, family 300.00)

| Allowed amount net of other insurance | Individual met | Family met | Remaining individual; remaining family | Deductible applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100.00 | 120.00 | 280.00 | 30.00; 20.00 | 20.00 |
| 100.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 150.00; 300.00 | 100.00 |
| 100.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 0.00; 150.00 | 0.00 |
| 100.00 | 40.00 | 300.00 | 110.00; 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

- A denied line applies nothing to the deductible.
- A service class on the tier's exempt list takes no deductible, whatever the remaining amounts.
- Adjudication order governs: a line for an earlier service date adjudicated after the deductible was met does not reopen it.
